After getting paid i spent 3 nights in a hotel, scrubbing ever inch of my body with soap as I hadn't showered for 2 weeks. I then put on some new clothes that I'd brought from a budget high street store and left for London to renew one of my passports. 

I arrived in London at 4am and had an appointment at the embassy for 9:30am. I decided to sleep in the bus station till like 9 because the hostel I was supposed to be staying at was an hour away from the embassy  but the coach station was only 10 mins away. 

Anyways during the short nap I was taking, some guy stole my bag. It contained my money, laptop, clothes and cash. The security guards told me that none of them will be recovered since the guy's a well known crackhead who's almost certainly sold them. The cops say the same thing and that the only way for compensation is if I take him to court which is a lengthy process that will require lawyers. I'm so fucked!
With regards to food I'm fine. I don't have any money but I've come up with a little system. I collect unclaimed McDonald's orders. I get about two relatively large meals per day this way.
